name: coverage
//: The line-coverage driver (coverage.sh: clear / test <crate> / report) every crate's test target and coverage-aggregate:coverage call, with its end-to-end test, which builds a scratch crate under cargo-llvm-cov. Its own project so only an edit to the driver reruns that slow test. Its inputs are only its own files (no workspace-wide globals), so the cached test result replays unless the driver, the test, or the cargo / cargo-llvm-cov versions (runtime inputs) change.
